༁ྃ:gnam chos thugs gter snyan brgyud dam pa rigs brgya'i sgrub thabs kyi lhan thabs gson byang bzhu thabs bsdus pa'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs gter snyan brgyud dam pa rigs brgya'i sgrub thabs kyi lhan thabs gson byang bzhu thabs bsdus pa'o//

kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de'ang bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ gson byang bzhu tshul gsungs nas/ rgyud rnams kun las thun mong du// cho ga 'di ni rab tu grags// zhes de ni gzhan thams cad la sbyar chog gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud dang srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gdams sogs las kyang*/ ting nge 'dzin la brten nas gson shog bya tshul dang*/ rgyud sde thun mong pa phal cher rdzas gcig la brten pa'i sbyin sreg gsungs pa yang don gson shog tu ngos 'dzin srol 'dug pas/ lam 'bras las kyang de nyid sgrib sbyong gi gtso bor bshad pa ltar 'dir dgod par bya ste/ rgyas par byang bu'i gzugs bris pa'i snying gar nṛ dang ming yig sogs spyi ltar bri/ bsdu na ming yig kho nas chog ste/ mdun du bshams la gyer sgom sbrags par bya'o// na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: rang nyid rdor sems sku mdog dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje: thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pa yi: dril bu dkur brten zhabs sems skyil: sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol: rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ru: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par bskyed: mgrin par rig 'dzin lha tshogs gsal: klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su: khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: dam ye dbyer med dran rdzogs gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: zhes ci lcogs bzla/ mdun du ming byang dang*/ rdza gsar pa'am lcags snod du me khrol mang zhig dang*/ theb rtse'i nang du til lam ma rnyed na nyungs gzhi/ mar me'am me ru bzhag / rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ni// sku che ri rab dang mnyam pa// sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di dag ni// sa thag nye ring gar yod kyang*// rang gi mdun du ming yig dang*// dbyer med nyid du gsal ba yi// snying gar paṃ yig nag po la// lus ngag yid kyi sdig sgrib bstim// rkang mthil yaṃ las rlung g.yos pas// lte 'og raṃ las me 'bar bas// snying ga'i paṃ yig gyen du ded// sdig pa rwa can rnam pa ru// sna bug g.yon nas thon gyur te// mdun gyi til la thim par gyur// mdun gyi me khrol mi dmigs pa// zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid ldan// de nang dam ye dbyer med pa'i// za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// gar dgu'i nyams ldan g.yas brkyangs bzhugs// zhal gdangs ye shes me chen 'bar// de yi zhal du sdig sgrib rnams// 'phul bas bsregs shing sbyangs par gyur// oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes pa grangs mi bzung mi rung ci lcogs shig til sngags re dang sbrag mer bsreg / oṃ badzra ḍā ka arghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ char sprin mdog can zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// dug lnga sreg byed bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar// srid gsum zil gnon spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs// sdig sgrib za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gror bstod// badzra ḍā ka badzra muḥ zhes 1$0000270rang bzhin gnas su gshegs par 1$0000300 bsam/ ming yig sbyin bdag dbyer med pa'i// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi// lte ba'i aḥthung ye shes me// 'bar bas phung khams skye mched dang*// sdig sgrib rnam smin lus bcas bsreg / me ru'am mar me thogs la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje lus kyi lte dbus na// dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum// aḥyig padma rā ga'i mdog /nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid can// ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// sgrib gnyis glo bur dri ma rnams// bsregs pas byang zhing dag par gyur// rgyas par na yig brgya/ 'bring bo dhi tsitta/ bsdu na badzra satwa la/ che ge mo'i sdig sgrib shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sbyar la me sbar nas/ ming yig bsregs pas de rnams kyi// sdig sgrib rnam smin lus dag nas// ye shes lus can bcom ldan 'das// zla steng rdor sems sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje// thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pa yi// dril bu dkur brten zhabs sems skyil// sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol// rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ru// zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni// rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par bskyed// mgrin par rig 'dzin lha tshogs gsal// klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su/ khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad// me long gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal// so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon dang*// bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam bskul// kun bzang rigs lnga thub pa drug

/mdog dkar kha ba bu yug ltar// 'byon nas lus mchog de la thim// sgrib gnyis dri ma sangs kyis dag /oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: sbyin bdag rnams kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sems dpa' brgyad dang sems ma brgyad// dzam bha la dang nor rgyun ma// gser mdog char ltar babs nas thim// tshe bsod ye shes nyams rtogs rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel rgyas gyur// oṃ sarba bo dhi satwa ārya dzam bha la/ sbyin bdag rnams kyi tshe bsod ye shes puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye oṃ/ rig 'dzin lnga dang ke'u seng sogs// mdog dmar sgeg cing chags pa'i gzugs// 'ja' 'od 'thib 'thib lus la thim// rlung sems snang ba dbang du gyur// hrīḥm ha ri ni sa/ sbyin bdag rnams kyi rlung sems rang dbang thob par gyur cig /pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ che mchog rigs drug thams cad ni// rab 'jigs shin tu khros pa'i tshul// char bzhin babs nas lus la thim// nyon mongs sdig sgrib bcom par gyur// oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ sdig ltung nyams chag thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ de ltar sgrib sbyangs dbang bskur pas// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar po// hūm̐ mthing gsum gyi rgyas btab cing*// 'od dang me dpung 'khrugs shing 'bar// bar chad bgegs kyis mi tshugs gyur// oṃ badzra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa/ sbyin bdag rnams kyi dus gsum bsags pa dang*// 'di ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams gang yod des// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med tshogs gnyis 'phel// phyi ma bde chen zhing du skye gyur cig /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog las nges par 'byung gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / ces brjod 1$0000270bdag dang sbyin bdag sems nyid dang*// rgyal ba'i thugs rnams dbyer med ngo bo gcig

/lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ngang la bzhag /1$0000300 gong gi dmigs pa'i rim pa de rnams kyang*// rdzogs chen lta ba'i ngang la thub na rab// ma thub dang po dmigs rim gsal bsgom zhing*// rjes nas dmigs med lta ba'i ngang la bzhag /lar ni 'di la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi// lta ba rtogs pa shin tu gal che 'o// de rnams gnam chos zhi khro'i kha skong du// rgyud gzhung man ngag mang po'i don bsdus te// sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bkas bskul nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa rā ga a syas sbyar// nyes 'gal mchis na zhi khro'i lha la bshags// dge bas 'gro kun sgrib gnyis kun bsregs nas// nam zhig 'phos tshe bde chen zhing khams su// rdzus te skyes nas sa bcu 'thob par shog /maṅga laṃ// gcig gam mang po'ang rung ste dmigs pa so sor zin pa gal che/// /
